# CollationICU

The ICU of [swift-foundation-icu](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-foundation-icu.git) at f986d0728da0766cf81f371521b909d4a11681d2 (ICU 76.1), with only
the data collation needs: 178 of its 4855 data items,
4.3 MB instead of
33.8 MB. The code is as it is
there; the data is `Sources/_NGCollationICU/common/icudt76l-collation.dat`, and the module is
`_NGCollationICU` (not `_FoundationICU`, which an app may have too).

Generated by `Scripts/vendor-icu.py`; don't edit it by hand. License: LICENSE.md
(ICU's and the Swift project's).
